domain: Enterprise SaaS / Knowledge Manufacturing Operating System
design_philosophy: Modern enterprise, professional, minimal, fast, responsive, highly organized, accessible. Clarity over decoration. Authority, clarity, function-first.

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist tech vibe: High contrast weights. Headings use 'tracking-tight'. Overlines/Labels are Uppercase + tracking-[0.2em].

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Control Room Grid for Dashboards: Density, Data Correlation, Scanability.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align for data, inputs, and dense content. Center only for isolated cards or empty states.

components_rules.cards_and_surfaces: Flat solid background, subtle 1px border, max 4px radius (rounded-sm or rounded-md). No shadows by default. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow (shadow-sm).
components_rules.buttons: Sharp, clean, high contrast. Only use primary color for main CTAs.
components_rules.tables_and_grids: Dense, highly organized data grids with clear column headers. Striped rows or border-b for separation.
components_rules.glassmorphism: Avoid glassmorphism. Use solid backgrounds to maintain data clarity and enterprise authority.

image_urls.description: Abstract blue and white geometric background for the Executive Command Center header.
Professional headshot for the 'Chief Executive Agent' or User Profile.
Professional headshot for the 'Research Director' or other AI agent.
Spacious and bright modern corporate office area for login page or empty states.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG contrast compliance. Text on primary elements must be white (#FFFFFF). Tint greys towards blue/cool.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use React with .jsx/.js extensions. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx).
Set up a global layout with a collapsible sidebar (navigation to all enterprise divisions) and top header.
Integrate 'Outfit' font for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text.
Build the Executive Command Center: KPI cards, charts (using Recharts or Shadcn charts), and a Workflow timeline/visualization.
Build the Knowledge Records page using a data grid/table for fast scanning.
Build the Manufacturing Orders page using a Kanban board with drag-and-drop or visual lane states.
Build the AI Digital Workforce section displaying employee cards (using the provided headshot URLs).
Implement the Conversational Command Center (chat interface) as a slide-out panel or a dedicated central view for executive commands.
Customize Shadcn components heavily: 4px border radius, 1px solid borders, and remove heavy default box-shadows.
Ensure 'data-testid' is strictly added to all buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and actionable components for robust testing.
